notes:
vpn -- the image vpn-1 runs from: hibr, and longwire splicing the remote-access network (192.168.152.0/24) to the owner's other sites over longwire's switchboard.

glibc is named because a named image gets only what its manifest names (see chrony's notes); hibr and longwire link it. bash is longwire's runtime dependency: its launchers are /bin/sh scripts. openssl is hibr's (src/net.c dlopen()s libssl). hibr and longwire roll on their gitea tags; glibc rolls like jumpbox's.

1.0.1: tcpdump, so vpn-1 can capture on its own interface (whether a peer's punch packets arrive).

1.0.2: nftables, which longwire's exit feature needs (longwire ADR 0056, a profile with exit=yes). Pinned at router's 1.1.1-5. Added at the owner's word, 2026-11-05.
